camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi ConfigX --region cn-hangzhou --CustomerPoolKey FC50000000000000000000000a1a --ReqId 5640000000000879 --TelX 17000000022 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Configures an X number to independently manage communication features such as voice calls and enterprise business cards for a work number
description_zh: 配置X号码，单独对工作号的话音呼叫、企业名片等通信功能进行配置操作
name: ConfigX

parameters.help_en: The request deduplication ID. The maximum length of reqId is 20 characters. The caller must ensure atomicity
parameters.help_zh: 请求去重ID，reqId最大长度为20位，接入方需要保持原子性
parameters.name: req_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the number pool
parameters.name: customer_pool_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pass through the caller ID to display the actual caller. Valid values:

00: No pass-through. The work number is displayed when either party calls the other.

10: Pass-through. When Customer A is the caller, the caller ID displayed to Employee B is the number of Customer A. When Employee B is the caller, the caller ID displayed to Customer A is the work number.

Default value: 00
parameters.help_zh:
是否透传来显为真实主叫，取值：

00：非透传，互相拨打时都显示工作号。

10：透传，A客户为主叫时，B员工的来显为客户A号码；B员工为主叫时，A客户的来显为工作号。

默认为 00
parameters.name: gn_flag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pass through the SMS signature to display the actual user. Valid values:

0: No pass-through.

1: Pass-through.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
是否透传来显为真实用户，取值：

0：不透传。

1：透传。

默认为0不透传
parameters.name: sms_sign_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the SMS feature. Valid values:

0: Disable.

1: Enable
parameters.help_zh:
开/关短信功能状态，取值：

0：禁用。

1：开启
parameters.name: sms_ability

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the call capability. Valid values:

0: Disable.

1: Enable
parameters.help_zh:
开/关呼叫能力状态，取值：

0：禁用。

1：开启
parameters.name: call_ability

parameters.help_en:
The sequential ringing mode. Valid values:

0: No sequential ringing. This is the default value.

1: Conditional sequential ringing. The system first connects to the callee specified by calledNo. If the callee cannot be connected, the system sequentially rings the numbers in the sequenceCalls list.

2: Unconditional sequential ringing. The system does not connect to the callee specified by calledNo and directly sequentially rings the numbers in the sequenceCalls list
parameters.help_zh:
顺振模式，取值：

0：不顺振（默认）

1：有条件顺振，先接续calledNo指定被叫，如果该被叫未能接通，再顺振sequenceCalls号码列表。

2：无条件顺振，不接续calledNo指定被叫，直接顺振sequenceCalls号码列表
parameters.name: sequence_mode

fields.help_en: The playback code for the sequential ringing prompt tone. The format is the same as callNoPlayCode
fields.help_zh: 顺振提示音放音编号，格式如callNoPlayCode
fields.name: sequence_call_no_play_code

fields.help_en: The callee number for sequential ringing
fields.name: sequence_called_no

fields.help_en: The playback code for the caller and callee after the call is connected. The format is the same as calledPlayCode
fields.help_zh: 接通后主被叫放音编号，格式如calledPlayCode
fields.name: sequence_called_play_code
